title: The judge's answer
description: What a judge test session of the scored authoring test answers about one result (tools/scored-run/README.md, "The judge"). judge.ts parses the session's last words against it; an answer that is not this shape, names another request, or does not answer exactly the request's questions is recorded as malformed, never guessed.

request.description: The id of the request the answer is about, as the prompt gave it.

answers.description: One entry per question id the prompt asked, and no other.

answer.description: yes: the result does what the question asks; no: it does not; cannot-tell: the files do not let the judge decide.

reason.description: One sentence, for the person running the test; never recorded.
